caption:
Friday du'a: there is a short hour you don't want to miss.

The Prophet ﷺ spoke of a time on Friday when a Muslim who is praying and asks Allah for something will have his request met. He pointed with his hand to show how short that time is.

Sahih al-Bukhari 935 · Grade: Sahih

Write down one du'a now, so it is ready on your lips today.

#hadith #fridaydua #jumuah #sunnah
alt_text: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) talked about Friday and said, "There is an hour (opportune time) on Friday and if a Muslim gets it while praying and asks something from Allah, then Allah will definitely meet his demand." And he (the Prophet) pointed out the shortness of that time with his hands (Sahih al-Bukhari 935)
